newsitem.title: USA: Reliv International Inc sets payout.
newsitem.headline: Reliv International Inc sets payout.

text.p: Reliv International Inc said Monday its board declared a cash dividend of $0.02 ar share, payable June 13 to shareholders of record as of May 30.
The payment of future dividends will depend on the revenues, earnings, capital requirements and other factors considered relevant by the board of directors, the company said.
In February, it paid a 10 percent stock dividend and a cash dividend of $0.005 a share.

Reliv manufactures and distributes several lines of food products, including nutritional and fiber supplements, diet management products, functional foods, sports drink mixes and premium skin care products.
